title: 第92章 对你很无语第91章 你这么骚包好吗
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
三人背靠背，三双眼睛同时盯着那几人，暗自防备皆没有说话。
“这就是你说的肥羊？”来人中为首的是那个胖的肥如猪的男修，他此刻眼神黏在赵致然身上，似乎在评估他身上这身华服的价值。
“是的，潘爷。”那修为最低的男修点头哈腰，一派阿谀奉承之态。
听了这话，李婉眉头皱紧，木青的臭脸更臭了，赵致然脸上更是黑沉一片。
她就说，出门要低调！
不低调只会成为别人的猎物。
“上，捉住这三只小肥羊。”
那四人呈现包围之态朝着三人围攻而来，李婉抽出彩霞，挡住朝自己刺来的长剑。
一股锋利的灵气划过皮肤，血珠从白皙的脸上落下，来人的主灵气是金属性，这还是李婉第一次遇到主金灵气的修士。
金灵气和冰灵气一样锋锐，却有着冰灵气没有的肃杀。
攻击李婉那位女修也被冰灵气的凌厉寒冷惊讶到。
她用她那双黑漆漆的眼睛，看了一眼李婉脸上尚且带着稚气的脸，便大概猜到眼前三人的来历。
冰灵根这等万人难出的资质，非大宗门和世家难见，世家出行，身后护卫重重，好认得很。
不会和眼前三人一般形单影只，故而只有一个可能。
这三位许是香炉宗的弟子。
不能伤其性命。
女修很快就在心里做出了决定。
这种资质在大宗门也是稀缺的存在，若伤了她性命，必将引起香炉宗的报复。
不过她本就为求财，对取人性命没兴趣。
堂堂香炉宗弟子被她一个散修抢劫一空身上财物，想必宗门脸上也无光，不会为其与她为难。

毕竟那可是一个把面子焊在身上的宗门啊。
女修游走四方，最会审时度势，向来不做会给自己引来大麻烦之事。
心念转动间，女修的手却不停，长剑变幻姿势，再次朝着李婉攻来，李婉勉强接住了这一剑。
修为差异太大，她不是女修的对手。
偏偏那矮个的男修还想要趁乱摸鱼，一柄短刀悄无声息的刺向李婉侧腰。
李婉眼角余光瞥见，眼神一厉，手中凝结出冰箭，狠狠刺向男修的手腕。
惨叫声立即袭来。
趁着这时，李婉引动丹田中的一缕云气缠上那矮个的男修。
男修立即停止了喊叫，他立在原地，双目发直，嘴巴微张，神志已经飘向了幻境之中。
那女修看李婉的眼神更加阴翳，不愧是大宗门弟子，保命手段就是多。
不过，这些很快就都是她的了。
这么想着女修的心情又好了起来，不再试探，全力朝着李婉攻去。
李婉的眼中倒映着女修的身影，她和她的剑整个都融为了一体，她就是剑，剑就是她。
女修的身影在李婉瞳孔中幻化成了一柄散着金光的剑，整把剑都发着难以直视的锐利之气。
李婉心里很清楚，自己抵不住这一剑的威力，但是她不甘心，她不接受这样轻而易举的失败。
这一瞬间，李婉什么都不愿意去想，她想要尝试一下，抛却只有花架子的形，去寻找千里真正的神。
抛开那些冗杂的技巧和窍门，李婉的眼脑心皆在那女修身上。
手和脚在此刻生出了自己的意志，以一种决绝的姿态，令往常存在感极强的彩霞臣服。
这是李婉第一次摸到这种人剑合一，玄之又玄的感觉，她用心记住当下的感受。
伸剑，踢腿，旋腰，每一个动作都很简单，但连贯在一起却组成了一种奇特的效果。

她精准的格挡在了对方剑锋最薄弱的地方。
content_en:
The three of them were back to back, with three pairs of eyes staring at those people at the same time, silently guarding against each other.
"Is this the fat sheep you are talking about?" The leader of the visitors was the male cultivator who was as fat as a pig. His eyes were glued to Zhao Zhiran at the moment, as if he was evaluating the value of the gorgeous clothes he was wearing.
"Yes, Master Pan." The male cultivator with the lowest cultivation level nodded and bowed in a flattering manner.
After hearing this, Li Wan frowned, Mu Qing's stinky face became even more stinky, and Zhao Zhiran's face became even darker.
She just said, keep a low profile when going out!
If you don't keep a low profile, you will only become the prey of others.
"Go on, catch these three little fat sheep."
The four people were surrounding the three of them, and Li Wan drew out Caixia to block the long sword that was thrust towards her.
A sharp aura streaked across his skin, and blood beads fell from his fair face. The visitor's main aura was metallic. This was the first time Li Wan encountered a monk who mastered gold aura.
Golden spiritual energy is as sharp as ice spiritual energy, but it has a chill that ice spiritual energy does not have.
The female cultivator who attacked Li Wan was also surprised by the sharp coldness of the ice aura.
She glanced at Li Wan's childish face with her dark eyes, and roughly guessed the origins of the three people in front of her.
Binglinggen's qualifications, which are rare for tens of thousands of people, are rare to see except for large sects and aristocratic families. When aristocratic families travel, they are surrounded by many guards, making them easy to recognize.
He won't be alone like the three people in front of him, so there is only one possibility.
These three Xu are disciples of the Xianglu Sect.
His life cannot be harmed.
The female cultivator quickly made a decision in her mind.
This kind of qualification is also rare in large sects. If her life is hurt, the Xianglu Sect will definitely retaliate.
However, she only wanted money and had no interest in taking human lives.
A disciple of the Xianglu Sect, who was a dignified disciple, was robbed of all his belongings by a casual cultivator of hers. The sect must have lost face and would not embarrass her because of it.
After all, it was a sect that had face welded to its body.
Female cultivators travel around the world, are the best at sizing up situations, and never do anything that would cause big trouble for themselves.
While her thoughts were turning, the female cultivator's hand did not stop. The long sword changed its posture and attacked Li Wan again. Li Wan reluctantly caught the sword.
The difference in cultivation is too great, and she is no match for the female cultivator.
But the short male cultivator still wanted to take advantage of the situation, and silently stabbed Li Wan in the side with a short knife.
Li Wan caught a glimpse from the corner of his eye, with a sharp look in his eyes, ice arrows condensed in his hand, and he stabbed the male cultivator's wrist fiercely.
The screams came immediately.
Taking advantage of this moment, Li Wan caused a wisp of cloud energy in his dantian to wrap around the short male cultivator.
The male cultivator immediately stopped shouting. He stood on the spot, his eyes straightened, his mouth slightly open, and his mind drifted into the illusion.
The female cultivator looked at Li Wan with an even darker look. She was indeed a disciple of the sect, and she had many ways to save her life.
However, these were soon all hers.
Thinking of this, the female cultivator's mood improved again. She stopped testing and attacked Li Wan with all her strength.
The figure of the female cultivator was reflected in Li Wan's eyes. She and her sword were completely integrated. She was the sword and the sword was her.
The figure of the female cultivator turned into a sword with golden light in Li Wan's pupils, and the whole sword exuded a sharp aura that was difficult to look at directly.
Li Wan knew very well that she could not withstand the power of this sword, but she was unwilling to accept such an easy failure.
At this moment, Li Wan didn't want to think about anything. She wanted to give it a try, abandon her mere appearance, and find the true god of Qianli.
Putting aside those complicated skills and tricks, Li Wan's eyes, brain and heart were all on the female cultivator.
The hands and feet gave birth to their own will at this moment, and with a decisive gesture, Caixia, who usually had a strong sense of presence, surrendered.
This was the first time that Li Wan had touched this mysterious and mysterious feeling of the integration of man and sword. She carefully remembered the feeling at the moment.
Extending the sword, kicking the legs, turning the waist, each movement is very simple, but when connected together, they form a strangespecial effect.
She accurately blocked the opponent's sword at the weakest point.
